mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recipe_search_chunk (recipe_id, version, document_text, embedding_json) VALUES (#{recipeId}, #{version}, #{documentText}, #{embeddingJson}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE version = VALUES(version), document_text = VALUES(document_text), embedding_json = VALUES(embedding_json)
mapper.select: SELECT recipe_id AS recipeId, document_text AS documentText, embedding_json AS embeddingJson FROM recipe_search_chunk ORDER BY recipe_id
